source_text: Lists of useful properties of morphisms of schemes

<STRUCT_0001>
For ease of reference we list in the following remarks the
properties of morphisms which possess some of the properties
required of them in later results.

Here is a list of properties/types of morphisms
which are <TEXTITOPEN_0001>stable under arbitrary base change<TEXTITCLOSE_0001>:
<STRUCT_0001>
<STRUCT_0002> closed, open, and locally closed immersions, see
Schemes, Lemma <REF_0001>,
<STRUCT_0003> quasi-compact, see
Schemes, Lemma <REF_0002>,
<STRUCT_0004> universally closed, see
Schemes, Definition <REF_0003>,
<STRUCT_0005> (quasi-)separated, see
Schemes, Lemma <REF_0004>,
<STRUCT_0006> monomorphism, see
Schemes, Lemma <REF_0005>
<STRUCT_0007> surjective, see
Morphisms, Lemma <REF_0006>,
<STRUCT_0008> universally injective, see
Morphisms, Lemma <REF_0007>,
<STRUCT_0009> affine, see
Morphisms, Lemma <REF_0008>,
<STRUCT_0010> quasi-affine, see
Morphisms, Lemma <REF_0009>,
<STRUCT_0011> (locally) of finite type, see
Morphisms, Lemma <REF_0010>,
<STRUCT_0012> (locally) quasi-finite, see
Morphisms, Lemma <REF_0011>,
<STRUCT_0013> (locally) of finite presentation, see
Morphisms, Lemma <REF_0012>,
<STRUCT_0014> locally of finite type of relative dimension <MATH_0001>, see
Morphisms, Lemma <REF_0013>,
<STRUCT_0015> universally open, see
Morphisms, Definition <REF_0014>,
<STRUCT_0016> flat, see
Morphisms, Lemma <REF_0015>,
<STRUCT_0017> syntomic, see
Morphisms, Lemma <REF_0016>,
<STRUCT_0018> smooth, see
Morphisms, Lemma <REF_0017>,
<STRUCT_0019> unramified (resp.<SPACE_0001>G-unramified), see
Morphisms, Lemma <REF_0018>,
<STRUCT_0020> <ACCENT_0001>tale, see
Morphisms, Lemma <REF_0019>,
<STRUCT_0021> proper, see
Morphisms, Lemma <REF_0020>,
<STRUCT_0022> H-projective, see
Morphisms, Lemma <REF_0021>,
<STRUCT_0023> (locally) projective, see
Morphisms, Lemma <REF_0022>,
<STRUCT_0024> finite or integral, see
Morphisms, Lemma <REF_0023>,
<STRUCT_0025> finite locally free, see
Morphisms, Lemma <REF_0024>,
<STRUCT_0026> universally submersive, see
Morphisms, Lemma <REF_0025>,
<STRUCT_0027> universal homeomorphism, see
Morphisms, Lemma <REF_0026>.
<STRUCT_0028>
Add more as needed.
